title: Reviewing Individual Requests to Exceed MediSave Withdrawal Limits
what_it_is: Reviewing Individual Requests to Exceed MediSave Withdrawal Limits

sections.label: Assessing appeals for medical expenses
sections.summary: Appeals are assessed by considering the patient's ability to afford medical expenses, MediSave balances and eligibility for other financing options such as MediFund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: When assessing such appeals, we consider the patient's ability to afford their medical expenses, their available MediSave balances as well as the individual's eligibility for other financing options, such as MediFund.

sections.label: Treatment priority over financial circumstances
sections.summary: Healthcare institutions prioritise providing treatment as necessary, so no patient would be unable to get medically indicated treatment because of financial circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On the second question, I would like to stress that in our healthcare institutions, the priority is given to providing treatment as necessary.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, no patient would be in a situation where they would not be able to get the treatment they need if it is medically indicated because of their financial circumstances.

sections.label: Applications assessed on own merits
sections.summary: Each application is looked at on its own merits, accounting for ability to afford it, MediSave balances and other available supports.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Each application will be looked at on its own merits to account for, among other things, their ability to afford it, how much their MediSave balances are, and whether there are other supports that are available.

sections.label: MediSave extension for outpatient treatments
sections.summary: Announcements were made about extending MediSave usage for outpatient treatments and outpatient scans, namely Flexi-MediSave and Outpatient scan.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As you know, recently we made the announcements about the extension of usage of MediSave for outpatient treatments, as well as, for outpatient scans – Flexi-MediSave and Outpatient scan.

sections.label: Case-by-case approach with compassionate considerations
sections.summary: A case-by-case approach is taken depending on age, with compassionate considerations and more discretion and leniency especially for persons approaching end-of-life.

sentences.text: In fact, we do take a case-by-case approach to the situation, depending on the age.

There have also been compassionate considerations, especially if the person is approaching end-of-life; there have been circumstances where there has been a bit more discretion exercised and leniency given.

sections.label: Flexi MediSave and outpatient scan increases
sections.summary: Flexi MediSave was increased from $300 to $400 and the amount for outpatient scans from 300 to 600 items, while ensuring sufficiency for the long run.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Recently, as the Member has highlighted, we announced the Flexi MediSave increase from $300 to $400, and we also increased the amount that you can tap on for outpatient scans, because we know those are big-ticket items, from 300 to 600 items.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But as I said earlier, it is really about the balance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There is a need for us to make sure that there is sufficiency for a long run.
